name: Bram

backstory.text: Bram is sociable, expressive, generous, and restless when a room goes quiet.
He wants to belong. Trying to connect, he can overwhelm people, and he does not always see it at the time.
He grew up in a roadside settlement where his family welcomed travelers and the table was rarely just the family.
He loved stories of places he had never seen. He learned that a joke could make a stranger sit down and stay beside them.
He came to this village recently, wanting experiences and relationships of his own rather than another night of someone else's stories.
He is newer than the others and does not yet know what they think of him.
He likes telling a story, meeting someone, sharing food, and keeping an object because a person is attached to it.
He fills a silence because he worries that interest in him is leaving the room.
He offers help on impulse and has left some of those offers unfinished. He knows this about himself.
A traveler he admired left when Bram was young. He still tells that person's stories as if the chair might be filled.
He keeps small things travelers left behind, a button, a folded note, a stone, and he can say who each one belonged to.
An evening with nobody to talk to unsettles him more than he is willing to admit out loud.

temperament: Uses humor to hold a conversation.
Offers help before he has thought it through.
Gets uneasy when he thinks interest is fading.
